item.title: Rediscovering AWS Firecracker and my experience on AWS Community Day in Colombia and Bolivia
item.description:
Hi everyone! In this post I’m going to talk about Firecracker and MicroVMs and their importance during this new AI era we are living in. This is more like a summary of the talks I presented at the AWS Community Day Colombia 2026 and AWS Community Day Bolivia 2026. I received some messages from folks insterested on this topic, so I feel happy to share it here!

Why I proposed this talk

I checked Firecracker for the first time back in 2021 (more on that below), couple years later when I had a use case for this, I found out I couldn’t use it in a real AWS environment as it required metal EC2 instances (that has KVM enabled via), unfortunately before February 2026, you could have nested virtualization only on metal instances which had way more specs that I nedded for PoCs, and of course expensive.
